summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing of FREKANSLA v0.1. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed covering identity persistence, session creation, certify (Ed25519 signing + L0/L1/L2 credentials), object listing/get/download (Content-Disposition), verify AUTHENTIC + tamper INVALID + missing-signature UNVERIFIABLE, provenance (HARDWARE_ATTESTED + OBJECT_SIGNED), publish (kora_ref + status attested/synced), diagnostics inspect/check/verify/doctor + unknown-command 400. Frontend: Creative Engine loads, transport-play toggles, 3 knobs + intention-morph sphere respond to drag, goto-certify navigates to /certify. Certification Portal: run-certification animates 4 steps to done, object-summary shows Ed25519 signature, fk-explorer lists the new object, diag-doctor prints VERDICT: AUTHENTIC in diagnostics-console, package-fk href points to /api/objects/{id}/download, export-audio present, publish-kora updates status chips to FREKCORE SYNCED / DAW SYNC ACTIVE / HARDWARE ATTESTED and shows 'Published to KORA' toast. No JS errors, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py verify_engine catches Exception broadly in frek_crypto.verify_signature - acceptable for prototype, but could log the failure reason for observability.
generate_identity stores enc_private_key in Mongo; ensure FREK_MASTER_KEY is rotated/backed up in production (documented as prototype constraint).

known_dids_set() considers ALL identities in DB as known, including inactive ones. In v0.1 with single identity this is fine, but for multi-identity future the AUTHENTIC vs VALID distinction relies on a proper FREKCORE registry.
test_credentials: n/a (no auth in v0.1, FREK-ID auto-generated)
seed_data_creation: Test session 'TEST_Session_1' + certified .FK object created via backend tests; 'Aurora Grit' objects created via frontend runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_frekansla.py currently pass. Frontend testids verified: transport-play, knob-warm-analog/harmonic/spatial, intention-morph, goto-certify, run-certification, object-summary, fk-explorer, diag-doctor, diagnostics-console, package-fk (anchor with href), export-audio, publish-kora. Note: 'plugin-window' testid is NOT present on the container div, but the plugin UI renders correctly (SonicFlow etc.) — not blocking; add data-testid="plugin-window" on PluginWindow root if strict coverage desired.
